im-c49-01.h: -기는 하지만 (Conceding then Contrasting) vs -지만 (Simple Direct Contrast)

a.h: -기는 하지만 (Admitting a fact first before offering nuance)
a.d: Used to acknowledge and validate the preceding premise or the listener's statement before introducing a counter-perspective.
ex: 가격이 조금 **비싸기는 하지만** 제품의 품질은 정말 뛰어나요. — The price is a bit high, to be sure, but the product quality is truly superb.

b.d: Used for straightforward factual opposition without the cushioning nuance of deliberate acknowledgement.
ex: 가격은 **비싸지만** 품질은 좋아요. — The price is high, but the quality is good.

im-c49-01.tip: Use -기는 하지만 as a conversational cushion to validate your listener before disagreeing politely. Often shortened to -긴 하지만 or -긴 한데 in speech.

im-c49-01.hint: Conceding an adjective quality first uses -기는 하지만: 품질이 좋기는 하지만...
im-c49-01.why: Admitting an acknowledged trait before contrasting takes -기는 하지만 (or contracted -긴 하지만).

a.h: -(으)ㄴ/는 반면에 (Weighing two sides side by side)
a.d: Used to balance two different traits, entities, or pros and cons objectively against each other.
ex: 이 제품은 **성능이 뛰어난 반면에** 가격이 다소 비쌉니다. — While this product has outstanding performance, the price is somewhat expensive.

b.d: Used when an actual event or condition causes a baffling or disappointing outcome contrary to common sense.
ex: 비싼 약을 **먹었는데도** 감기 증상이 전혀 낫지 않아요. — Even though I took expensive medicine, cold symptoms did not improve at all.

im-c49-02.tip: Use -(으)ㄴ/는 반면에 for balanced pros and cons or personality contrasts; use -(으)ㄴ/는데도 when expressing surprise or regret that expectations were overturned.

a.d: Used when an actual past or present factual occurrence yielded an unexpected, regrettable result contrary to reason.

a.d: Used in discussions to validate the other party's point before stating reservations or constraints.
ex: 맞는 **말씀이기는 하지만** 현실적인 예산 문제가 있습니다. — That is true, to be sure, but there is a realistic budget issue.

b.d: Used in formal reports and analytical meetings to contrast two distinct performance metrics neutrally.
ex: 수익성이 **높은 반면에** 초기 설비 투자 비용이 큽니다. — While profitability is high, initial facility investment is heavy.

im-c49-04.tip: Choose -기는 하지만 when managing human conversation diplomatically; choose -(으)ㄴ/는 반면에 when contrasting data or traits objectively in reports.
